faq.q: What is a titanium cotter pin (din 94)?
faq.a: A titanium cotter pin (din 94) is a precision-machined fastener component used in split cotter pin for hinge/clevis retention. Manufactured from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What is the typical application for titanium cotter pin (din 94)?
faq.a: Titanium Cotter Pin (DIN 94) is designed for split cotter pin for hinge/clevis retention. The Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V grade is selected to provide the optimal balance of strength, fatigue life, and environmental resistance for this specific application.

faq.q: How is titanium cotter pin (din 94) manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Cotter Pin (DIN 94) is manufactured using Cold heading. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium cotter pin (din 94)?
faq.a: The most common issue is thread galling (cold welding) when titanium threads mate without anti-seize compound. Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.
